entries.summary: Created the Puffling desktop companion project and illustrated README.
Expanded the README with a visual walkthrough of Puffling's behavior.
Added Outlook calendar and Microsoft To Do reminders in speech bubbles.
Added the Happy Ghast skin and refreshed previews and README artwork.
Added support for up to three independent Pufflings and synchronized pair and trio interactions.
Documented follow-up work in the project TODO.
Numbered the TODO items and added plans for a tap-to-open computer overview and desktop assistant features.
Added repository instructions to log completed work and commit each task locally; created the project activity log.
Reorganized the TODO into four ordered milestones with visible checkbox item numbers, from assistant foundations through features and pet polish.
Deferred the desktop assistant milestones to the bottom of the TODO and prioritized pet movement, behavior, and presentation.
Made travel and follow face left or right clearly at desktop sizes, smoothed turns on reversals, added regression tests and facing previews, and completed TODO 1.
Added persistent roster-slot variants with distinct harness and goggle accents, idle and wandering rhythms, and playful behavior weights; verified group routines and completed TODO 3.
Fixed frame smearing in all 14 Happy Ghast preview GIFs by setting each frame to clear to the transparent background; verified README loops and completed TODO 5.

Expanded Puffling individuality with red, blue, and green faces, temperaments, click reactions, and solo moves; added synchronized chase, bounce sparring, and three-pet pong games and refreshed the README previews.
Rewrote AGENTS.md with project-specific build/test/preview commands and conventions, and replaced TODO.md with ROADMAP.md, adding a Later ideas section of proposed features.

Added ambient reactions to detected music, video, coding, and coding-agent activity (Grooving/Watching/Coding/AgentBusy clips and Brain.SystemActivity), a pixelated-font notification bubble, and a roadmap milestone of further interaction and animation ideas; completed ROADMAP 4.

Made group play rare (every 3-5 min) and personality-shaped: a shorter, separate duo routine (dance/chase/staring contest) now pairs two of three Pufflings by temperament affinity (red-blue most, red-green sometimes, blue-green least), and a lone Puffling eventually plays a one-off 'looking for someone' clip; completed ROADMAP 34.
Documented in AGENTS.md that a running Puffling.exe must be stopped before building or testing, since it locks the DLLs the build needs to copy.

Made the drag-and-flick release fluid and floaty: it now keeps more of the throw's momentum (0.6x -> 0.8x) and decelerates far more gently (900 -> 300 DPI-scaled units/s^2) instead of snapping to a stop.
Updated the AGENTS.md running-instance rule to also start the app back up after build/test, so stopping it to test doesn't leave the user without their companion.
Shrank the oversized speech bubble (300x82 -> 220x64, less padding) and dropped the pixel font back to 10pt to match Windows Terminal's default size.

Added billiard-ball collision between companions (CompanionCollision): overlapping pets are pushed apart and exchange velocity on the collision normal, so flicking one into another shoves it instead of passing through; dragged pets stay pinned but still shove, and choreographed group routines are exempt. Completed ROADMAP 35.

Softened the companion collision bounce: added a restitution coefficient (0.35) instead of a full elastic velocity swap, so colliding pets settle toward a shared speed rather than bouncing off each other hard.

Added an instant screen-edge bounce (ScreenEdgeCollision): a companion is clamped to the nearest safe point and its overshoot velocity reflected the moment it would leave the comfortably-visible area, instead of drifting off-screen until the slower ReturningBehavior caught up. Multi-monitor crossing is unaffected. Completed ROADMAP 36.
